hook_clarity.why: Nine-word first line states the problem viewers may have had.

factual_accuracy.why: Every sentence maps to c1-c3, each backed by an opened OBS release page.

natural_delivery.why: Short spoken sentences; version numbers read naturally.

narrative_coherence.why: One thread: update, crash, workaround, fix, action.

audience_relevance.why: Streamers and creators use OBS; the fix is actionable.

practical_takeaway.why: Clear action: update to 33.0.3 if you stream or record on an older PC.

ending_quality.why: A short question that invites people to share whether they were hit.

no_redundancy.why: Each line adds a new step of the story.

no_jargon.why: Only 'CPU' and 'processor', both familiar to creators.

no_unsupported_implications.why: Says 'certain older processors' and 'could crash', never that everyone was affected.

audience_check.why_care_today: The fix shipped today, two days after a buggy update.
audience_check.affects_life_or_work: Creators who stream or record with OBS depend on it opening.
audience_check.surprising: Mildly: a hotfix needed its own hotfix.
audience_check.demonstrable: The release page and version number can be shown on screen.
audience_check.clear_consequence: Update and the startup crash on older CPUs should be gone.
audience_check.would_share: Creators may send it to a friend who streams on an old PC.
audience_check.right_audience: Yes: creator-tech is a core audience for this account.

practical_takeaway.who_can_use: Anyone who streams or records with OBS Studio, especially on an older Windows PC
practical_takeaway.what_it_does: 33.0.3 fixes the startup crash that 33.0.2 caused on certain older CPUs
practical_takeaway.availability: Released 22 Nov 2026 on the OBS Project's GitHub releases page (Windows, macOS, Ubuntu builds)
practical_takeaway.price: Free (OBS Studio is free and open-source software, GPL-2.0)
practical_takeaway.difference: 33.0.2 users on affected CPUs no longer need to roll back to 33.0.1 or 32.2.2
practical_takeaway.limitations: Which CPUs are affected is not specified; the fix note names Windows
practical_takeaway.why_it_matters: A crash at startup can cost a creator a stream or a recording session

learning_applied: No Instagram performance data is connected or recorded yet, so today's choice uses the documented V7 virality model unchanged.
